'''Prep4Hire Jawa Madness (MKOS)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Prep4Hire]]
* '''Published:''' 23 August 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive|My Kind Of Scum]]
* '''Strategy:''' My Kind Of Scum
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed MKOS Prep4Hire LS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is an updated version of my old Jawa deck I used to take to tournaments from time to time.  The sad thing is, this has won me tournaments.

== Strategy ==

Not really too hard to play. . First turn if you have enough force, or don't fear a first turn beatdown, pull Audience Chamber and then Herat.  If you must, pull the Audience Chamber and then wait till next turn to pull and and get her some backup like Boelo or Ephant Mon.  Use Herats game text to pull the Utinni! (V) and use that to pull Wittin and Nebit if he's there, if not, any jawa.  You wanna try to get either Scum, Jawa Camp or Chall out quick so you can lay down the jawas fast.  Get a quick flip and just drain and retrieve.  Thanks to the new Jawa Pack, Wittin should be a little safer with a defense value of 4, but not much.  Just play around with it a little, it's a blast to play.
